## 1. Objective

docs: propose declaring enqueue refusal once per registered executor

P0041 keeps the capability and rejects removal: only a refused offer makes a ThreadPoolExecutor grow before queueing, which pool topology cannot express. It proposes moving the per-unit flag to executor registration, failing registration on a queue that cannot honor it, and leaves the registration API shape, per-unit demand, and nested-only scoping open.
